## Constraints & Preferences
- Canonical GitHub repository `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` is the sole source of truth.
- **OWNER CONTROL REQUIREMENT (effective immediately)**: All production work under owner's accounts (GitHub, Render, Supabase, AWS, Domain/DNS, Android signing, Apple Developer). No Rork-owned repos, personal repos, temporary repos, hidden branches, private forks, or alternate deployment sources. Before every deploy: verify GitHub HEAD, Render connection, deployed SHA, live /version SHA. After every deploy: return GitHub repo, branch, commit SHA, Render deploy ID, live /version SHA, SHA parity confirmation.
- Never expose credentials, OTPs, passwords, bearer tokens, service-role keys, or personal identities.
- `main` branch is protected — requires 1 approving review (temporarily relaxed for merges, then restored each time).
- Owner directive: implement Instagram-style instant loading — 0% loading spinners in any module, app, or landing page.
- Owner is NOT a developer — needs simple tap-by-tap instructions for AWS Console actions.
- Owner wants app completed 100% and deployed now.
- Kotlin and Swift don't mix — only sync Expo/backend/.github files to GitHub, not native Android/iOS source.
- Owner explicitly demanded honest proof evidence — no false certifications. Prior claims of "certification complete" were overstated.
- Owner provided email `iperez4242@gmail.com` and password directly in chat for authentication. Password must never be logged or stored in plaintext.
- Owner demanded final accountability audit comparing IVX IA Senior Developer and Autonomous to current repository (not earlier certifications), with exact missing code, missing functions/classes/APIs, estimated LoC, engineering time, gap classification, and prioritized completion plan.

  title: string,
  body: string,
): Promise<{ prNumber: number; prUrl: string }> {

      Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
